question: The cost of painting a spherical ball at the rate of ₹2.50 per cm² is 13,860. What is the diameter of the ball? (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of painting = ₹13,860

Rate of painting = ₹2.50 per cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Cost = Rate × Surface area

Surface area of sphere = 4 × π × r²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface area = 13,860 ÷ 2.50

⇒ Surface area = 5,544 cm²

⇒ 4 × 22/7 × r² = 5,544

⇒ (88/7) × r² = 5,544

⇒ r² = (5,544 × 7) ÷ 88

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = 21 cm

⇒ Diameter = 2 × 21 = 42 cm

**∴ The diameter of the spherical ball is 42 cm.**
